Definition: Jerubbaal, a symbolic name of Gideon
BiblicalUsage: Jerubbaal is the name Gideon was given after he tore down the altar of Baal. In Judges 6:32, Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal. The fuller story is told on the Gideon profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jerubbaal shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
